ten_second.ground: The will has an orientation, toward God or away; call it its sign.
ten_second.question: Can a will turned away turn itself back by its own operations?
ten_second.break_it: Show one internal operation open to a creature that reverses its moral orientation, or show that the formal sign does not represent that orientation. Either premise failing takes C8.1 down.

sections.heading: The question
paragraphs: Every person faces somewhere. The old word for turning around is repentance, and the old puzzle is whether the turning is ours to start.
This paper defends a narrow answer: no person can flip their own sign, provided the moves open to a fallen will keep its orientation. The precise claim is below.
